# Gather data regarding cattle origin in Mexico to port of entry in the US


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(stringi)
source("src/normalize_state_name.R")
```

# Load georeferenced bovine data by state
```{r summarize-bovine-by-state}
bovine_state_summary <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "geolocated_bovine_state_summary.rds"))
glimpse(bovine_state_summary)
```

# Load port data

```{r load-port-data}
port_volume_by_state <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "port_volume_by_state.rds"))
glimpse(port_volume_by_state)
```


#    - Percent of state inventory moving to each port
```{r percent-state-inventory-to-port}

## Align state names between the two processed datasets.
#state_name_overrides <- c(
#    "michioacan" = "michoacan",
#    "distrito federal" = "ciudad de mexico",
#    "mexico" = "estado de mexico"
#)

port_state_clean <- port_volume_by_state |>
    mutate(
        state_norm = normalize_state_name(state)
        #,
        #state_norm = recode(state_norm, !!!state_name_overrides)
    )

bovine_state_clean <- bovine_state_summary |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    transmute(
        state = municipio,
        total_state_bovine = total_de_bovinos,
        state_norm = normalize_state_name(municipio)
    )

state_port_joined <- port_state_clean |>
    left_join(
        bovine_state_clean,
        by = "state_norm",
        relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) |> rename(total_port_volume = total_volume)

unmatched_states <- state_port_joined |>
    filter(is.na(total_state_bovine)) |>
    distinct(state = state.x, state_norm) |>
    arrange(state)

unmatched_states

# 1) Total volume from each state to each port.
state_to_port_total_volume <- state_port_joined |>
    transmute(
        year,
        state = coalesce(state.y, state.x),
        port,
        total_port_volume
    ) |>
    arrange(year, state, port)

state_to_port_total_volume_wide <- state_to_port_total_volume |>
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = port,
        values_from = total_port_volume,
        values_fill = 0
    ) |>
    arrange(year, state)

state_to_port_total_volume_wide

# 2) Total volume from each state to each port divided by total bovine in each state.
state_to_port_volume_per_bovine <- state_port_joined |>
    transmute(
        year,
        state = coalesce(state.y, state.x),
        port,
        total_port_volume,
        total_state_bovine,
        port_volume_per_bovine = if_else(total_state_bovine > 0, total_port_volume / total_state_bovine, NA_real_)
    ) |>
    arrange(year, state, port)

state_to_port_volume_per_bovine_wide <- state_to_port_volume_per_bovine |>
    select(year, state, port, port_volume_per_bovine) |>
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = port,
        values_from = port_volume_per_bovine,
        values_fill = 0
    ) |>
    arrange(year, state)

state_to_port_volume_per_bovine_wide

write.csv(
    state_to_port_total_volume,
    here("outputs", "tables", "state_to_port_total_volume.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
    state_to_port_volume_per_bovine,
    here("outputs", "tables", "state_to_port_volume_per_bovine.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
    state_to_port_total_volume,
    here("data", "processed", "state_to_port_total_volume.rds")
)
saveRDS(
    state_to_port_volume_per_bovine,
    here("data", "processed", "state_to_port_volume_per_bovine.rds")
)


print("Come back to these that are not matched!!:")
print(unmatched_states)

```
